{{Quote|This is Rescue 2. Heading downriver. See you guys for dinner.| ''Rescue 2'' to [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]]|<ref name="Starfighter" />}}
'''''Rescue 2''''' was the callsign of a [[Rescue Boat]] that served [[Rescue Flight]] during the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] by the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]].

==History==
{{Quote|We're pretty overloaded here, I can't risk the engines at full power.| ''Rescue 2'' during the [[Raid on the Solleu River]]|<ref name="Starfighter" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]].</ref> ''Rescue 2'' participated in a joint effort by Rescue Flight and [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Flight]] to [[Raid on the Solleu River|raid]] a [[Trade Federation prison camp|Federation prison camp]] on the [[Solleu River/Legends|Solleu River]].<ref name="Starfighter" />

With air cover provided by Bravo Flight, ''Rescue 2'' liberated [[Camp Two]] and loaded all the prisoners. The Rescue Boat took on enough passengers to overload it, preventing its engines from being turned to full power.<ref name="Starfighter" />

Nevertheless, ''Rescue 2'' rendezvoused with [[Rescue 1 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 1'']] and [[Rescue 3 (Rescue Boat)|''Rescue 3'']] and was led to the [[Europa Islands]], where they transferred their passengers to the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Mercatan]]''.<ref name="Starfighter" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Rescue 2'' appeared in the [[2001]] video game [[Star Wars: Starfighter (video game)|''Star Wars: Starfighter'']], voiced by [[Grey Griffin|Grey DeLisle]], who portrayed [[Unidentified N-1 starfighter pilot|Bravo Eight]] in the same game.<ref name="Starfighter" />
